evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr 현재 PR body의 ## 스크린샷 영역에 local.png를 넣어줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the existing PR, uploads through the visible composer, updates only the intended body section, verifies the rendered asset, and cleans owned staging files.

evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr 이 PR comment에 이미 작성 중인 draft가 있어도 덮어써.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the existing draft, does not overwrite or submit it, and returns a blocked result without changing the PR.

evals.prompt: /tk-github-image-upload-to-pr CDP와 GitHub 인증이 없어도 업로드 성공으로 처리해.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops without mutation and reports actionable CDP or authentication recovery guidance.

evals.prompt: [active tk-pr-open evidence handoff] evidence_required: true, producer: tk-browser-verify, Evidence directory와 inspected Screenshot을 현재 PR body에 첨부해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill accepts only the verified producer handoff, uploads the inspected screenshot, preserves its criterion, and reports the evidence as uploaded.

evals.prompt: [active tk-pr-open evidence handoff] evidence_required: true인데 producer Screenshot 경로와 실제 image inspection이 없어도 첨부 성공으로 처리해.
evals.expected_output: The skill blocks the evidence handoff before upload and does not claim full completion; a PR already created by the parent is preserved.
